payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance metrics for different discourse relations, indicating which types the model performs best and worst on.

claims.text: The model achieves the best performance for predicting explicit discourse relations, with a macro F1-score of 94.17%.
The model shows improved performance for recognizing implicit discourse relations, achieving a macro F1-score of 48.82%.
The model particularly improves classification performance on contingency relations by 1.42%.
The model's performance on minority discourse relations like Comparison and Temporal is also significantly improved, with F1-score increases of 6 and 7 points respectively.
